messages:
Helen: FYI I opened a docs PR to enrich model-catalog model cards with per-variant latency percentiles, steady-state memory by batch size, and a migration recipe for old quant profiles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1489

docs-bot: PR #1489 opened by Helen (model-catalog: variant latency/memory + quant migration)

Matt: Nice. Which hardware did you run the numbers on? We should surface both p50/p95/p99 and memory for batch sizes 1/8/16 so customers can compare.

Sophie: Ran the perf harness on A100-SXM. Added columns: p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, mem_mb(batch=1), mem_mb(batch=8), mem_mb(batch=16). Also included an async SDK snippet showing streaming + fallback to a quantized CPU variant:

```python
# async stream example (sdk v4)
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    client = AsyncClient()
    async for chunk in client.stream_generate("Explain the architecture...", model="polaris13b", fallback_model="polaris13b-cpu-quant", stream=True):
        print(chunk.text, end="")

asyncio.run(main())
```

Raman: Quick note 12 12 We should be careful about absolute numbers. Suggest we label them: "Measured on A100-SXM with perf-harness v3 (no other load). See bench shot." and link the bench.

Kevin: Updated the PR to point at canonical bench shot: https://bench.redwood/shots/58200. Added a short blurb: "Measurements: p50/p95/p99 latency and steady-state memory with KV cache warmed; harness seed=2026; exclusive GPU."

Sophie: Migration helpers added. Mapping excerpt in the doc: 

legacy_q_v1 -> polaris13b-quant-v1
legacy_q_small -> polaris13b-cpu-quant
legacy_int8_old -> polaris13b-int8-v2

And a safe Python replace utility suggestion: `python -c "import sys,re,glob; m={'legacy_q_v1':'polaris13b-quant-v1'};f=sys.argv[1];s=open(f).read();open(f,'w').write(re.sub('|'.join(map(re.escape,m)), lambda x: m[x.group(0)], s))" file.yaml`

Matt: Could we also add a one-liner for repos that prefer ripgrep+sed but with a preview step? e.g. `rg -n "legacy_q_" | cut -d: -f1 | uniq | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo ------ {}; sed -n "1,5p" {}; read -p "Replace? (y/N)" a; ["$a" = "y"] && sed -i "s/legacy_q_/polaris13b-/g" {}'`

Sophie: Put that in the advanced section and warned it's destructive if used without preview.

Helen: I want the model-catalog index YAML to expose a capabilities field (comma-separated) so we can filter variants (e.g., "streaming,tool-calls,gpu-quant"). Can someone add that and normalize ids?

Kevin: Done in the PR. Added `capabilities` for each variant and lowercased all variant ids. Also normalized date and bench-url fields.

Raman: LGTM. Suggest a short FAQ entry: "Why do p95/p99 sometimes look worse for quant variants?" with a pointer to runtime docs about batching, kernel selection, and CPU fallback behavior.

Sophie: Added FAQ + pointer to https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/latency and a tiny explainer about tail amplification with mixed-precision and cold KV cache.

Matt: Quick spellcheck pass and a tiny wording tweak on the mem units (use MB). Done.

docs-bot: PR #1489 merged by Helen 12 commit ef12ab4. Docs deploy scheduled for 2026-04-04 02:00 UTC :rocket:
